_provenance.how: read decimals()/totalSupply()/name()/symbol() of 0x4200...0006 at a pinned block and compare them against native wei, then look for a real deposit tx
_provenance.proves: that the chain's wrapped gas asset is 18-decimals 'Wrapped Ether'/'WETH', so a raw WETH unit and a wei of native ETH are the same size and token profit can be netted against gas cost without any scaling factor
_provenance.does_not_prove: that WETH and ETH are worth the same to a market - here they are the same asset by construction, which is why the wrap/unwrap pair is the only denomination bridge used
